lede: The week's biggest item is Tuesday's Town Council work session, where three consequential threads come together: a deep dive into the Comprehensive Plan, a Gondola Subcommittee update, and — most notably — a review of proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies, which cuts right to the heart of who gets to stay in this valley. Alongside that, the Housing Authority Subcommittee takes up the Martin exception request on Wednesday, and Ouray County's Planning Commission meets virtually to work through possible Land Use Code definition changes.

notable.stake: Third-party rental housing audit proposals reviewed — directly shapes who can afford to stay.
Martin exception for deed-restricted unit roof repair comes to a decision after August continuance.
Land Use Code definitions under revision — early-stage changes that shape future development rules.
Conditional-use permit for temp tent and food truck advances to Council recommendation.
